verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports exporting findings in open, standard formats (SARIF, JSON) and SBOMs for supply-chain data, plus an AppSec Platform API to list deployments/findings/projects, and the CLI itself runs locally without required cloud upload — all pointing to low lock-in. However there's no explicit documentation of a full account/data export or deletion workflow covering all AppSec Platform data (rule configs, history, PR comments) in one open bundle. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export/portability guarantee, evidence of exporting custom rules/config in bulk, and independent confirmation that platform-stored history can be fully extracted and account closed.
